text:
Maya: Quick sync — thinking of a tiny webinar + bench to test 3 things: 1) free credit amount sweet spot, 2) prompt templates that increase first-run success, 3) routing inbound signups to self-serve vs SDR. short run, 1 week.
Alex: Love it. What's the hypothesis on credit size? smaller is cheaper but might not show value.
Maya: Hypothesis A: $5 starter credit = enough to run 5 API calls and hit aha. Hypothesis B: $15 to let them finish a small promptpack flow. Goal: lift 7-day activation by +8%.
Sam: For prompt templates, can we test two families: "task-first" vs "persona-first"? Keep them to 3 variants each.
Riley: Routing idea: tag inbound leads with utm_medium=miniweb and if usage in 24h > X tokens, route to SDR queue; else keep self-serve nurture drip.
Jen: Need the tracking snippet. Suggest we standardize UTM like: 
```
?utm_source=launch&utm_campaign=hourglass-nudge&utm_medium=miniweb
```
Then include `utm_variant` for prompt family.
Alex: Metrics dashboard: activation = any successful generate + followup action (save/share or create project). CPL estimate? we should cap credit spend per cohort.
Maya: Agreed. Budget: up to $2k credit burn across cohorts. If conversion > target, scale.
Sam: Creative ask: 2 subject lines, 1 short demo script (90s), 1 hero prompt example. I can draft.
Riley: Can we wire webhook from signup to routing lambda? I can add a simple rule: if tokens_used>200 in first 6h then tag "hot".
Jen: I'll coordinate the email drip variants and set up the click tracking. Can we include a one-click "apply credits" CTA in the demo?
Maya: Yes. UX team ok with modal flow. @Alex can you confirm backend flow for auto-crediting?
Alex: Will need a small endpoint. Pseudocode:
```
POST /apply-credit { user_id, code }
if user.eligible: credit(user, amount)
return 200
```
I can have it in staging by EOD tomorrow.
LaunchBot: Deployment scheduled: staging -> canary at 2024-05-09T22:00Z :rocket:
Sam: Timeline: creative drafts by Tue, promptpack tested Wed-Thu, miniwebinar Fri, run Mon-Fri next week.
Maya: One more: bench narrative doc — short bullet list for comms: baseline latency/cost, expected uplift, sample session replay. Sam can draft.
Jen: I'll map inbound routing to SDR playbook with followup SLA (reach out within 24h for hot leads).
Riley: I'll add the route rules and a test harness.
Alex: I'll add telemetry tags so we can break down LTV by prompt family.
Maya: Perfect. @Sam @Jen @Riley please post a one-line daily status in this thread while we run. :eyes:
Sam: Will do.
Jen: Copy that.
Riley: On it.
Maya: Thanks team — small, tight experiment. If it hits targets we scale credit amount and widen cohort.
